The user wants to find the yearly tuition for "nursing assistant" at Harbor Valley Evening School for the year 2025.
I have been navigating through multiple pages of the "Full 2025 tuition fee schedule".
I have checked parts 1 through 8.
Part 8 says: "This part of the 2025 admissions overview lists no figures. Figures are published in a later part." and provides a link to part 9.
I need to fetch part 9.
